question: ___________ exerts influence on the sustenance of people dwelling adjacent to the wetland.
solution:
The Correct answer is **'Depletion of water quality.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank refers to a factor that affects the lives of people living near wetlands.
 
• The passage discusses various threats to wetlands, including pollution.
 
• Polluted water can harm the health and livelihoods of people who depend on wetlands.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** 'Depletion of water quality.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 3.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1)** Rapid coastland erosion**: This may indirectly affect some wetlands.
 
• Option 2) **Recreational activities**: While recreational activities can impact wetlands.
 
• Option 4)** Agricultural patterns:** Agricultural practices can contribute to water pollution
